annotations.title: Find a pundit, outlet, team or player

description: Look up the slug MissedTakes uses for a pundit, a publication (outlet), an NFL team, an NFL player or a prediction type, by full or partial name. Call this first whenever the user names someone: the other tools take slugs, never names. Only pundits and outlets with a public page are returned.

kind.description: Restrict to one kind. Omit to search all five.

query.description: A name or part of one, e.g. "Kiper".
